title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1973-09-07
lineage: AUDMC (AKG 1000 mic > Sony 110 deck. ) > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: A surprisingly clear audience recording of the legendary 9/7/73 show captures a fire‑filled second half with standout Bird Song, Here Comes Sunshine and the Truckin’→Eyes jam, despite minor static and a slow start.
ai_review.review: This AUD delivers near‑perfect instrument separation that lets the band’s 1973 brilliance shine through – especially the explosive second set jams from Truckin' into Eyes of the World. While the recording has a few blemishes (early‑set tuning noise and occasional guitar fuzz), the overall listening experience is highly enjoyable and energetic.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 5‑star, praising both performance and recording; only a few note minor flaws, resulting in a strong combined score weighted toward the show quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audible instrument separation is unusually clear; birdsong highlighted as outstanding. Minor issues include a slow start, occasional static/fuzz on Jerry's guitar and a brief drop‑in of crowd noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set opens a bit sluggishly, likely due to tuning, but builds into an energetic second half where jams flow seamlessly from Truckin' through to Eyes of the World.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Generally praised for his playing; a few reviewers note occasional static and fuzz on his guitar due to equipment issues.
band_member_comments.Drums: Described as fabulous and well‑balanced in the audience mix.
